text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 645 单元

Zulu
音标：英 /'zu:lu:/  美 /'zʊlʊ/
n. 祖鲁语；祖鲁人
adj. 祖鲁人的
例句：And why should an English speaker be barred from reading blogs written in Malagasy or Zulu?
而且为什么用马达加斯加语或者祖鲁族语写的博客，说英语的人就看不了呢？
例句：This Zulu Proverb can be applied to leadership in Africa today.
今天，祖鲁族人这句谚语可以应用到非洲的领导身上。
typingText:
And why should an English speaker be barred from reading blogs written in Malagasy or Zulu?

This Zulu Proverb can be applied to leadership in Africa today.
